verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships `llama serve` (a server) and a built-in web UI that runs against it. That suggests the UI is a client of the same server interface, which implies API parity, but the pack never describes the API surface or confirms parity explicitly. Missing for 10: documentation of the server API endpoints, explicit statement that all UI functions (chat, vision, settings, model loading) are exposed via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven usage.
